item.title: BTC Market Pulse: Bitcoin Drifts Below $78,700 Amid Modest 24-Hour Decline
item.summary: BTC/USD closed at $78,610.275 on the Alpaca five-minute bar ending 2026-08-26 10:30 UTC, up 0.22% over 30 minutes but down 0.83% over 24 hours, while CryptoQuant flagged a 10-month high in weekly U.S. spot Bitcoin ETF inflows.
